exact: feature_sign_at_t (control has the same current sign as the event's final phase)
context_covariates.htf_state: sign(EMA20 - EMA50) of completed H4 closes (4h buckets starting 00,04,..; available when bucket end <= t close); ewm adjust=False; 0 before 50 buckets
context_covariates.standardisation: SD of each covariate over the eligible bars of the same period (context only; no outcomes)

control_pool: eligible bars of the same period: finite features, 16-bar forward outcome available, not within +/-16 bars of any event of the same feature (either pattern), same exact strata
events: exact events from results/pnp_bar_census_full/events.csv (detector, thresholds, refractory and timestamps unchanged); trend_bias and ema_spread events are identical and are analysed once as family 'ema_spread'

families.note: PNP and NPN are distinct families; tests = 6 features x 2 patterns x 4 horizons = 48 per period

hypotheses.H1: context-only linear model of raw forward return (htf dummies, volatility regime dummies, hour dummies, prior_ret_16, prior_ret_64, volatility_ratio) fitted on discovery bars, out-of-sample R^2 on holdout bars
hypotheses.H2: paired difference d = aligned(event) - aligned(control); day-cluster bootstrap (4000) CI and p; also pooled OLS of aligned return on context + event indicator with day-clustered SE (primary matching only)
hypotheses.H3: same sign and holdout BH q < 0.05 in the chronological holdout after the discovery freeze

matching.primary: 1:1 nearest neighbour, per-covariate caliper 0.5 SD, no replacement, greedy in event time order

sensitivity.hour_relaxed: session + 4-hour bucket instead of exact hour
sensitivity.k3_replace: up to 3 nearest controls with replacement (mean of controls)
sensitivity.non_overlap: primary pairs, events thinned to >= 16 bars apart

matching.unmatched: events without a control in caliper are dropped and counted

multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg across the 48 family x direction x horizon tests, separately in discovery and holdout
observation_landmark: bar close of the confirmation bar t; every covariate uses bars <= t

outcome.alignment: multiplied by the event's final-phase sign (+1 PNP, -1 NPN); the matched control inherits the event's sign
outcome.missing: pair dropped for the horizon if timestamp[t+k]-timestamp[t] != 15min*k for event or control; events/controls need the 16-bar outcome so every horizon uses the same sample
outcome.overlap: forward windows of nearby events overlap; inference clusters by calendar day of the observation bar

periods.freeze: stage=discovery writes discovery_freeze.json (sha256 of discovery summary and spec); stage=holdout refuses to run without a matching freeze

promotion_rule: NONE promotable from this experiment. Support requires discovery BH q<0.05 AND holdout same sign AND holdout BH q<0.05 AND holdout CI excluding 0 AND >=3 of 4 sensitivities same sign in both periods. Anything else = inconclusive/unsupported in scope. No production change either way.
purpose: Does a confirmed P->N->P (or N->P->N) transition add information about forward price movement beyond matched market context?
